summary: Add the centralized AxiomCore release control plane and stage changed runtime, host, SDK, runner, CLI, and documentation components through reviewed candidate versions and evidence.

changes.summary: Add typed Rust extension APIs, Python and TypeScript SDK boundaries, and multilingual sandbox runtime support.
Fix browser host rendering and interaction handling for Acore UI bundles and extension-backed actions.
Repair the Android host's staged renderer build and align emulator delivery with the updated extension runtime.
Rebuild the iOS host against the updated extension runtime and native UI bundle contract.
Rebuild atmx-web against the typed extension runtime and shared browser SDK interface.
Rebuild the release worker with updated Acore server, UI module, and shared contract models.
Improve mock data generation, mutation responses, and server behavior for Acore backend demos.
Rebuild contract-test execution against updated Acore and UI models.
Document extension dependencies, authoring migration, and current SDK support boundaries.

queued.summary: Rebuild atmx-react against the verified atmx-web package and updated runtime interface.
Separate Flutter plugin and native runtime versions, then pin the verified Apple framework.
Refresh the Swift package's immutable XCFramework checksum after the Apple runtime is verified.
Add extension dependency workflows, multilingual source builds, and Inspector improvements to the CLI; use the new central release control plane for its distribution.
